description: Exploratory paired two-arm ablation of the fee-cap headroom bound. Holds the S=.75/U=.50, D16, half-RB threshold, K10 mechanism fixed while comparing the historical worst-case next-price bound max(1/D, (1-target)/(target*D)) against the pure worst-case upward step (1-target)/(target*D). The two coincide at the urgent target 0.5, so only the standard lane's admission and EB-producer checks differ. Ten paired seeds across the five headline loads are intended as a directional smoke test, not confirmatory evidence.
